diagnostics.message: aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_service writes to the aws_billing_report bucket and requires the bucket policy granting `bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com` (statement `EnableAWSDataExportsToWriteToS3AndCheckPolicy`) to already exist. Data Exports validates write access to the destination bucket when the export is created, so without an ordering edge to aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy the create can fail with Access Denied. The graph only shows a dependency on aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report.

aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource writes to the aws_billing_report bucket and requires the bucket policy granting `bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com` (statement `EnableAWSDataExportsToWriteToS3AndCheckPolicy`) to already exist. Data Exports validates write access to the destination bucket when the export is created, so without an ordering edge to aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy the create can fail with Access Denied. The graph only shows a dependency on aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report.

aws_s3_bucket_notification.cur_notification declares three `lambda_function` blocks (cur_per_service, cur_per_resource, cur_per_resource_process) but its `depends_on` only covers aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_service and aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource. The third lambda_function block references module.cur_per_resource_process, so the aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource_process statement may not exist yet when PutBucketNotificationConfiguration validates the destination, causing "Unable to validate the following destination configurations".

aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_service sets `function_name = local.cur_per_service_lambda_name`, an interpolated string that does not reference the Lambda module. Terraform therefore sees no edge to module.cur_per_service and may call AddPermission before the function exists, which fails with ResourceNotFoundException. The permission must be created after the function.

aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource sets `function_name = local.cur_per_resource_lambda_name`, an interpolated string that does not reference the Lambda module. Terraform therefore sees no edge to module.cur_per_resource and may call AddPermission before the function exists, which fails with ResourceNotFoundException. The permission must be created after the function.

aws_lambda_permission.cur_per_resource_process sets `function_name = local.cur_per_resource_process_lambda_name`, an interpolated string that does not reference the Lambda module. Terraform therefore sees no edge to module.cur_per_resource_process and may call AddPermission before the function exists, which fails with ResourceNotFoundException. The permission must be created after the function.
